q1.sampleAnswer: My name is Li Ming. I’m thirteen years old. I live in Hangzhou, in China. My favourite day at the weekend is Saturday, because I can get up late and play football with my friends. I usually eat noodles for lunch at the weekend. Sometimes my mum makes dumplings. Last weekend I went to the park with my family. The weather was sunny and we had a picnic. I enjoyed it because we played games together. I speak English every day at school, and sometimes at home with my sister. Learning new words is easy for me, because I like reading English stories.

keyPoints.descZh: 语法与词汇：简单语法结构的掌握，日常话题词汇的运用
互动交流：回答切题，内容充分，能延展回答
整体表现：能用简单的语言完成交流任务

q1.explanationZh: 好的回答能直接回答每个问题，并多说一两句理由或细节（例如为什么喜欢周六、周末做了什么、天气怎样），用简单而正确的句子连贯表达。

q2.sampleAnswer: I like trainers because they are comfortable and I can run in them. I don’t like caps very much, but they are useful in summer. I don’t think wearing jeans is boring, because you can wear them every day. Wearing sunglasses is important in the sun because it protects your eyes. Trainers are cool, and many students wear them. Wearing a cap in the sun is a good idea because it keeps your head cool. A watch is useful, but I don’t wear one. I like trainers best. I prefer using my phone to tell the time, because I always have it with me. At school we can’t wear much jewellery, maybe only a small watch or a simple bracelet, because it isn’t safe in PE lessons.

q2.explanationZh: 好的回答会对图片中的每样穿戴物品表明喜欢与否并给出理由，能回答考官的追问（如牛仔裤、太阳镜、手表等），说出最喜欢哪一样，并用 because 等连接词展开。
